title: Lore-Forge entry front matter, schema version 1
description: YAML front matter of one entry file (<typeFolder>/<id>.md). The Markdown body follows the closing ---. Unknown keys are allowed and preserved.

date.description: [~]DATE [ERA], or unknown / ?. DATE is YYYY, MM.YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY, DD.MM (day and month, year unknown) or the older YYYY-MM / YYYY-MM-DD. In MM.YYYY the year needs 3+ digits (0050), a minus sign or an era code; otherwise two numbers are DD.MM. ~ = approximate.

type.description: Usually a type from the relation table (RELATION_KINDS in @lore-forge/core); custom types are allowed.

status.description: character: alive/dead/unknown; place: standing/destroyed/unknown; faction: active/dissolved/unknown; item: intact/destroyed/lost/unknown. An ongoing status hides the end date in the editor; the value stays in the file.

visual.description: Free-text visual description for art. Usual keys: character appearance/build/clothing/palette/features/props; place architecture/climate/palette/scale; faction emblem/attire/palette; item material/size/details; event scene/mood. Other keys allowed.

chapter.description: Story Book chapter title override (events and notes).

bookOrder.description: Story Book order inside the chapter; default 0, lower first, ties by date then name.

images.description: Reference images, on any entry type.

file.description: Path relative to the world folder, normally images/<entryId>/<file>.

view.description: Kebab-case view label. Usual views per type: character a-pose/front/back/left/right/three-quarter/concept; place establishing/map/interior/exterior/mood/concept; faction emblem/banner/uniform/headquarters/concept; item front/back/side/top/detail/concept; event scene/establishing/map/mood/concept; note illustration/map/concept. Others are allowed (info warning image-view).
